response.answer: Your record supports a written-statements-first approach for contested mediations: you describe settled matters as suitable for quick live check-ins, but contested matters as better handled in writing. You say collecting written statements before the team-merger mediation surfaced the actual disagreement—two issues rather than ten—and helped it settle cleanly. You also note that the two-day lead-time cost is documented and affordable under the service agreement. The record preserves exceptions: true crises require an immediate room, and a prior walkout was attributed to a leaked email rather than the meeting format; a later live-first mediation with the same director went smoothly.
